scope: Target-aware u64/usize const function arguments and full-width unused generic literals/patterns, plus actual generic Type/Syntax and generic-record reflection composition. Broader trait and const families remain incomplete.

identity.algorithm: SHA-256 of repository-relative paths sorted by Python pathlib.Path component order, each UTF-8 path + NUL + exact file bytes + NUL
identity.production_selection: crates/**/src/**/*.rs; all files, not only changed files

binding: Both copied before target reuse and independently SHA-verified. All323 exact Git production files and both test sources independently reproduce author committed aggregate hashes using Path component order. New source fixtures are include_str inputs in bound binaries.
new_controls: Full u64 MAX and usize64 MAX survive concrete const forwarding; unused generic integer and match literal domains retain i128 internal identity and reject negative unsigned/out-of-range values.

Selected32-bit frontend accepts usize MAX and rejects MAX+1 even when the const argument is erased; source and project paths both exercised. Windows-x64 frontend Verify is checked only, not native Windows.

Actual generic function returns Type; generic record reflection selects an i64 field; Syntax<Type> preserves phantom arguments; Syntax<Expr> materializes a known scalar field. Copy alone does not grant scalar literal capability, unused invalid generic body rejects, and changed phantom nominal argument rejects.

Both new full source fixtures execute Clang/LLVM API O0/O2. The actual CT-materialized module recovered from trusted frontend cache is decoded and replayed independently through raw and byte Verify; recovery does not grant verifier authority.
source_review: Driver source/project expansion, CT selection Context, shape/impl snapshot freezing and read-view type expansion receive the selected TargetProfile explicitly; no mutable global or host-width substitution is used. Existing target-keyed session/cache identity remains in force.
Const normalization checks domain and selected width before specialization erases unused values; definition literal/pattern checking retains unsigned range in i128 rather than narrowing to i64.

This stage mostly proves existing CT generic composition under the integrated scalar/type implementation; it does not invent a new unchecked CT lowering or substitute a static alias for the actual generic source.
budget_controls: All measured work/node N accept, N-1 ResourceLimit, cold/warm/fresh and persisted controls replay in the eight-test harness. Default request limits unchanged; earlier milestone numbers remain historically bound.
